task:
Nudge the application's colour tokens toward the owner's concept pack (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-01-ui-concept-pack/). The owner approved this on 2026-11-04. Start from current main. apps/web only. Scope is ONLY the orange accent, the neon blue and the dark navy base/panel family. Do not change line colours (--line, --line-strong), --text, --text-muted, status colours (--ok, --warn, --danger), tier colours A-D, radii, fonts, spacing, layout, the renderer/scene palettes (Babylon clear colour, spectral star colours, density, nebula colours, region colours) or any asset.

EXACT NEW VALUES (measured from the concept images and contrast-checked; use these exactly) in the `:root` block of apps/web/src/app.css:
  --bg-void: #081728;          (was #080d17)
  --bg-deep: #0b1a2b;          (was #0b1220)
  --panel: #152230;            (was #121c2e)
  --panel-raised: #1a2a3a;     (was #172539)
  --panel-sunken: #0c1a2a;     (was #0d1524)
  --text-dim: #7a8fab;         (was #6f84a0; lightened so supporting text keeps at least its old contrast on the lighter panels)
  --accent: #fd6308;           (was #ff7a14)
  --accent-hi: #fd8930;        (was #ff9a3c)
  --accent-glow: 0 0 22px rgba(253, 99, 8, 0.35);   (was rgba(255, 122, 20, 0.35))
  --neon: #2c9bf6;             (was #3da5ff)
  --neon-hi: #47c5ff;          (was #5ec8ff)
  --neon-soft: rgba(44, 155, 246, 0.16);            (was rgba(61, 165, 255, 0.16))
  --line-glow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(44, 155, 246, 0.18), 0 0 24px rgba(44, 155, 246, 0.1);   (was rgba(61, 165, 255, ...))
Keep --accent-text (#1a0d02) as is.
Tier S identity stays fixed (the existing comment in app.css says tier identity does not change when the application palette changes): change `--color-tier-s: var(--accent)` to the literal `--color-tier-s: #ff7a14` so tier badges keep exactly today's orange; the pinned tierColors test value stays '#ff7a14'.

FIND AND UPDATE EVERY OTHER LITERAL COPY of the old values: search apps/web/src, apps/web/cypress and apps/web/static case-insensitively for `ff7a14`, `ff9a3c`, `3da5ff`, `5ec8ff`, `080d17`, `0b1220`, `121c2e`, `172539`, `0d1524`, and the rgb/rgba forms `255, 122, 20`, `61, 165, 255`, `rgb(61,165,255)` etc. For each hit decide: (a) it is a UI colour that should follow the palette, so replace it with the matching token (for example the hard-coded `outline: 2px solid #ff7a14` in GalaxySystemHoverCard.svelte should become `var(--focus)`; the fallback inside economy-presentation.ts `var(--accent, var(--color-signal, #ff7a14))` becomes the new accent literal as its fallback); (b) it is tier identity (leave); (c) it is a renderer/scene colour or test fixture that must not change (leave, and list it in the PR body with the reason). Do not leave any UI colour that still shows the old orange or old blue.

TESTS
- Update apps/web/src/lib/design-kit.test.ts: the pinned `tokens` map to the new values, the computed-style expectations (`rgb(61, 165, 255)` becomes `rgb(44, 155, 246)`, `rgb(255, 122, 20)` becomes `rgb(253, 99, 8)`), and any other pinned old value you find.
- Add a contrast guard test in design-kit.test.ts that computes WCAG 2.x contrast from the tokens in app.css and fails below these floors: --text on --bg-void, --panel, --panel-raised, --panel-sunken >= 7; --text-muted on the same four >= 4.5; --accent on the same four >= 4.5; --neon on the same four >= 4.5; --neon-hi on the same four >= 4.5; --text-dim on --bg-void, --panel, --panel-sunken >= 4.5 and on --panel-raised >= 4.0 (supporting text only); --accent-text on --accent >= 4.5. Expected figures for reference (they were computed before this task): the lowest are --text-dim on --panel-raised 4.4 and --accent on --panel-raised 4.8.
- Update any other unit test, Python contract pin (tests/test_*.py that pin these hex values: search tests/ too) or Cypress assertion that pins an old value.
- Run pnpm check, pnpm lint, pnpm format:check, pnpm test, pnpm build in apps/web (pnpm 11.25.0) and the touched Python contract tests.
- Keep Cypress product screenshots as they are; do not add new ones.

DOCS: if the redesign plan (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-v3-ui-redesign-plan.md) or any other current doc lists these token values, update it to the new values and say it was done 2026-11-04 at the owner's request, with the concept images as the source of the measurements.

CHANGES.md: add a new top entry with the exact heading `## 2026-11-04 — UI redesign: palette nudged to the concept` explaining in plain words what the owner will see (the orange is a touch deeper, the neon blue a touch deeper, the dark navy a touch bluer and lighter, nothing else), that tier S badges keep their old orange on purpose, that the maps/renderer colours are unchanged, and the contrast figures. Do not edit older entries.
